free_tier.stated: Free: 5,000 credits to start, valid 90 days, on a box of 4 vCPU / 8 GB; at 200 credits an hour that is 25 hours of awake time. S at $19 a month adds 5,000 credits a month, M at $39 a month adds 10,000.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is one cloud Ubuntu desktop with a persistent shell, not a stored object

retention.stated: A box asleep 14 consecutive days is deleted with its files and saves, 30 days if the account has paid for box or Sai, and never while it has an S or M plan; any wake resets the count.

egress.terms: A residential IP add-on costs 1,000 credits per 100 MB on paid plans; no general egress allowance or per-GB rate for ordinary traffic is published.

interface_detail: One hosted MCP server at https://mcp.box.simular.ai/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth sign-in), plus a live screen at box.simular.ai/box and a personal key for clients that cannot sign in.
tooling: Add the remote MCP URL to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode or VS Code, or run npx @simular-ai/box@1.2.2 connect on the user's own computer.
chaining: A 4 vCPU / 8 GB box at 200 credits an hour is $0.20 an hour, or $0.10 an hour at half duty; its persistent desktop keeps browser logins between agent sessions and hands files to other records.

limits.value: 5,000 free credits once, valid 90 days; 200 credits an hour for a 4 vCPU / 8 GB awake box, so 25 hours free

binding_note: The 5,000 credits expire after 90 days and are the first limit reached; at 200 credits an hour they buy 25 awake hours before the $19 or $39 plan or a top-up is needed.

identity_cost.detail: Sign-in is through a Simular account with Google or GitHub OAuth; the MCP connection opens a browser page where the person approves which boxes it may use and for how long. A personal bearer key from box.simular.ai/access works for clients that cannot sign in. No card is asked for on the free tier.

reliability_note: System images may be reconfigured, so installed packages can need reinstalling; an idle box is deleted after 14 days of sleep and a box's small model calls are billed separately from its awake time.
confidence_note: Prices, free credits, sleep deletion, the MCP sign-in and the credit rate are quoted from the vendor's own home page, docs and terms read on 2026-11-25.
